route_policy: Machine-readable claim route from tuple component to theorem assumptions, finite fields, evaluator predicate, positive/negative cases, and falsifier boundary.

theorem_assumptions: resolution regime rho supplies observational cells
tuple_component_bindings.evaluator_predicate: same rho cell blocks resolution_distinguished; cross cell permits cross_resolution_distinguished

theorem_assumptions: raw carrier may have raw separation
tuple_component_bindings.evaluator_predicate: raw separation alone is insufficient for K0 distinction

theorem_assumptions: distinction is read through declared quotient
tuple_component_bindings.evaluator_predicate: quotient distinction controls verdict

rows.falsifier_boundary: A proof that assumes every pair of raw real states is epsilon-separated is outside v12 and fails G33.

theorem_assumptions: death blocks live status
tuple_component_bindings.evaluator_predicate: death=true requires live=false

theorem_assumptions: death may produce typed residue
tuple_component_bindings.evaluator_predicate: residue id must be nonempty and not identity token

theorem_assumptions: rebirth is typed source/residue/target, not identity
tuple_component_bindings.evaluator_predicate: rebirth target must be token-separated and claimed identity continuation must be false

rows.falsifier_boundary: Any claim reading residue-preserving restart as same-identity survival is rejected unless endpoint-bound identity evidence is supplied.

theorem_assumptions: k=0 requires declared zero-cause
tuple_component_bindings.evaluator_predicate: at least one zero_cause must be active

theorem_assumptions: support/admissibility remain explicit
tuple_component_bindings.evaluator_predicate: missing live support rejects the zero claim

theorem_assumptions: cycle witness is part of the supported case
tuple_component_bindings.evaluator_predicate: active obstruction rejects k=0

rows.falsifier_boundary: A realization with undeclared zero-cause, missing live support, or any active obstruction may not promote k=0.

theorem_assumptions: boundary is a typed classifier
tuple_component_bindings.evaluator_predicate: classifier boundary accepts only declared classifier failure semantics

theorem_assumptions: metric language requires a measurement rule
tuple_component_bindings.evaluator_predicate: metric comparison is evaluated only when metric_measure_declared=true

rows.falsifier_boundary: A social or logical boundary represented numerically without a measurement rule is blocked by G40.

theorem_assumptions: operator route is explicit
tuple_component_bindings.evaluator_predicate: guard=true is the admitted guard/reset route and uses reset target; guard=false is checked by the separate no-guard step theorem and uses step target

theorem_assumptions: smooth notation needs chart/domain/local-law
tuple_component_bindings.evaluator_predicate: smooth-chart route rejects missing chart or missing local law

theorem_assumptions: proof/rewrite route rejects derivatives and requires rewrite rule
tuple_component_bindings.evaluator_predicate: proof/rewrite accepts only typed rewrite with derivative_requested=false

rows.falsifier_boundary: Any section treating a chart token as a differentiability, manifold, vector-field, or ODE-solution theorem fails G41.

theorem_assumptions: historical and effective axes are distinct bookkeeping fields
tuple_component_bindings.evaluator_predicate: historical sequence must be monotone while effective rank can drop in the no-send consistency witness

theorem_assumptions: no independent domain-rank theorem is promoted
tuple_component_bindings.evaluator_predicate: negative control rejects historical-axis erasure, not a domain-wide dimension law

rows.falsifier_boundary: A K-level is demotable only when the alleged new axis has no witness and no observable consequence.

theorem_assumptions: eligible live status requires cycle mode or maintenance
tuple_component_bindings.evaluator_predicate: maintenance loop accepts only when obligation and support are true

theorem_assumptions: live label is not static persistence
tuple_component_bindings.evaluator_predicate: live=true with cycle_mode=none and no support is rejected

rows.falsifier_boundary: An artifact that never updates, replays, checks, or maintains itself is archive residue, not live continuum.

theorem_assumptions: identity, residue, and rebirth are separated evidence classes
tuple_component_bindings.evaluator_predicate: rebirth/residue cases are rejected as identity unless endpoint-bound identity evidence is present

theorem_assumptions: residue token blocks identity continuation
tuple_component_bindings.evaluator_predicate: claimed identity continuation fails when residue token is present or invariant is lost

rows.falsifier_boundary: Any public claim reading rebirth as literal same-identity survival is blocked.

theorem_assumptions: each tuple component has a keep/drop witness
tuple_component_bindings.evaluator_predicate: keep verdict passes and one-component drop verdict fails for the named component

theorem_assumptions: component-specific witnesses are not label-only
tuple_component_bindings.evaluator_predicate: boundary witness flips exactly the boundary obligation

rows.falsifier_boundary: If any promoted tuple component can be removed while `FM-MIN-*` still returns PASS for the declared semantic verdict suite, the minimality card fails.

theorem_assumptions: adjacent K transitions require retained witness and demotion criterion
tuple_component_bindings.evaluator_predicate: transition row identity and added axis must match the atlas

theorem_assumptions: reduction fails only when witness remains observable
tuple_component_bindings.evaluator_predicate: upper witness changes verdict while reduced model loses the axis

theorem_assumptions: lawful demotion is explicit
tuple_component_bindings.evaluator_predicate: demotion control passes only when witness is unobservable

rows.falsifier_boundary: If any adjacent K row lacks row identity, retained-witness evaluator failure, or inert-witness demotion control, the finite negative control fails; independent semantic irreducibility remains unpromoted unless separately proven.
